posts.title: The rapid rise of solar power
posts.description: One of the books that shaped my outlook on the energy transition was Chris Goodall’s The Switch. It’s central argument is that the economics of renewable energy had shifted, and solar power would be the cheapest and most obvious power source for most of the world. posts.title: Book review: Beyond Techno-Feudalism, by Cédric Durant

posts.title: Would you live in a wind turbine?
posts.description: I recently read Aaron Betsky’s book on reuse in architecture, and enjoyed pursuing the idea across the internet. One project that caught my eye isn’t reusing a building per se, but reusing decommissioned wind turbines.
